name: routed_strip_boundary — o <= min(h_gb, lb) routing rule at the boundary (AUDIT-FIXES E, H6)

hand: Rule (AUDIT-FIXES E): an outboard UDL strip routes to the pier only if the strip length beyond the bearing OUTER
face satisfies o <= min(h_gb, lb) — 45-degree dispersion through the GB depth AND landing entirely within the
bearing width. Here h_gb = 24, lb = 24 -> limit = 24 in.
at_limit run: x_L = 3.0 ft = 36 in, lb/2 = 12 -> o = 36 - 12 = 24 in = limit exactly -> routes (pass, status ok).
above_limit run: x_L = 3.05 ft = 36.6 in on BOTH sides -> o = 24.6 in > 24 on both sides with a UDL present;
one failing side alone is modeled as a Case C overhang automatically, but BOTH sides failing is out of scope ->
input error whose message directs the user to the dispersion/bearing limit and Case C.
(The default case routes with room to spare: o = x_L - lb/2 = 15 - 15 = 0 <= min(24, 30) = 24.)
